blocks.text: Kim Molina is set to reprise her role as the titular superheroine in the upcoming revival of “Zsazsa Zaturnnah Ze Parteeeh!” which will return to the stage in April 2027. The musical’s cast was officially revealed during a press conference on Wednesday, Nov. 18, in Quezon City, with Molina returning to the role she played in Ateneo Blue Repertory’s 2023 production.
